QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_29

question.text: Gross IRR of a Category III AIF is computed using:

answer.text: Net cash flows after all fees
Gross cash flows ignoring fund expenses, fees, taxes

explanation.text: The Logic: Gross IRR is computed BEFORE deducting fund expenses, management fees, incentive fees, taxes. The Trap: Deducting fees gives Net IRR; distributions-only is DPI. Cross-Exam Context: Standard industry distinction. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always ask for BOTH Gross and Net IRR figures — the gap reveals fee load.
